title: Room Seven Twice (칠 호실이 두 번)

scenes.title: 삼십오 분
scenes.summary: Arthur panics over the double-booked room while Graham unlocks the third-floor staircase.

scenes.title: 아늑한 다락방
scenes.summary: Up in the quiet attic room, Hannah, Graham, and Tessa inspect the space and list what is missing.

scenes.title: 층계참에서 왼쪽으로
scenes.summary: Hannah, Tessa, and Arthur finish making the bed, plug in the warm lamp, and hear the front gate bell.

scenes.title: 빗속에서 들어온 손님
scenes.summary: Quiet architect Caleb arrives soaked from the rain, and Hannah and Tessa warm him up before explaining the room change.

scenes.title: 반값 할인과 고요한 들보
scenes.summary: Shown the cozy attic room at half price, Caleb admires the timber ceiling and happily takes the key.

scenes.title: 별 다섯 개짜리 안도의 한숨
scenes.summary: Downstairs Arthur celebrates the solved double booking until Hannah spots a small leather notebook left on the counter.

scenes.title: 수첩 돌려드리기
scenes.summary: Hannah returns Caleb's leather notebook and hears the radiator pipe clank and go lukewarm.

scenes.title: 얼음장 같은 배관
scenes.summary: Coming up from the cellar, Graham delivers bad news: the hot-water boiler valve just cracked for the night.
